correctness.rationale: For same-side vertices a_i,a_j, only landmarks in P_i union P_j distinguish under d_k; hence all but at most one matched pair must meet S, forcing size at least n-1. Equality gives one-per-pair transversals with one omitted pair. A selected third pair resolves each cross-side pair for n>=4. With diameter three, k>=2 domination follows; for k=1 every omitted matched mate requires at least two selected vertices of its side, yielding p,q>=2 and binomial count 2^(n-1)-2n. Independent direct distance-code enumeration for n=5,6,7 and k=1,2,3 recovered all predicted counts (30,120,350 for k1; 80,192,448 for k2 or k3). Finiteness of these checks is not used for universal quantification.
